posture: Inform — a clean scan. Nothing new bearing on EnergyCo or a declared REZ was published by any reachable free source between the Sunday evening run and this morning, and no item clears the relevance filter without duplicating the 28 or 30 August digests. RenewEconomy has not published since 29 August and its most recent piece has no NSW-REZ nexus; EnergyCo has published nothing since 21 August and ACEREZ nothing since 24 July. The live political thread from the weekend runs on today: One Nation formally launches its Victorian energy policy at Yallourn this afternoon, and at Sunday's preview the party declined to say how it would unwind existing renewable energy zone and interconnector contracts — that unwind question, not the abolition pledge already logged on 30 August, is the part with read-across to EnergyCo's access rights and network operator agreements. Source gaps are unchanged and material: afr.com, smh.com.au and theaustralian.com.au could not be retrieved even at headline level, theguardian.com is refused to the automated agent outright, and the NSW Planning Portal, AEMO, AER, AEMC and IPART feeds were not verified in-window. A quiet digest here means quiet across the sources that answered, not quiet everywhere.
summary: No new relevant items surfaced in the 30 to 31 August window. The digest is published with a single logging entry to preserve archive continuity and to record which sources answered clean and which could not be reached. Two diary items fall due today and this week, and the One Nation policy launch this afternoon is the next thing to read.

items.headline: Clean scan and unchanged source gaps logged for the 30 to 31 August window
items.summary: EnergyCo published nothing after 21 August, ACEREZ nothing after 24 July, and RenewEconomy nothing after 29 August, its latest article carrying no NSW-REZ nexus. pv magazine Australia, ABC News and the ACM regional titles returned nothing new in the window, and the ACM search index continues to lag the scan period by more than a week. Four gaps are recorded: afr.com, smh.com.au and theaustralian.com.au refused retrieval, so those mastheads were not scanned even at headline level; theguardian.com is blocked to the automated agent; and the NSW Planning Portal major projects list, AEMO market notices and newsroom, the AER, the AEMC and IPART could not be confirmed clean for the window.
items.so_what: The Planning Portal and AEMO gaps remain the ones that carry real exposure, since a determination, an exhibition opening or a REZ-region constraint notice would not have surfaced here and should be checked manually today. Three diary items sit on the register: the Illawarra REZ community reference group holds its first meeting today, submissions on the New England REZ draft declaration amendment close on 3 September, and the New England REZ network infrastructure project EIS is still flagged for lodgement in the second half of this year. One Nation's formal Victorian energy policy launch this afternoon should be read for how it proposes to treat contracts already signed under existing zone declarations, which is the transferable question for EnergyCo's access schemes.
